goal.objective:
Autoresearch goal: Peer-review and patch ARIA-NBV thesis sections against current thesis source order, seminar implementation evidence, litkg, theory docs, and external literature

Research methodology / professor-critic rubric:
Pass only if the work inspects current docs/typst/thesis/main.typ include graph and every included section; ranks inclusion candidates from .omx/specs/autoresearch-thesis-lit-review; compares thesis claims against docs/typst/seminar_paper/main.typ, local theory docs, litkg/literature archive, and targeted external literature; produces a conflict/citation/inclusion matrix with exact sources; patches docs/typst/thesis sections with close citations and dashy-todo markers for unresolved inconsistencies; verifies Typst compile and relevant hygiene checks or records blockers.

Completion gate: record a passing professor-critic verdict with omx autoresearch-goal verdict --slug peer-review-and-patch-aria-nbv-thesis-sections-a --verdict pass --evidence "<critic artifact/evidence>". After the objective audit passes, call update_goal({status: "complete"}), call get_goal again, then run omx autoresearch-goal complete --slug peer-review-and-patch-aria-nbv-thesis-sections-a --codex-goal-json "<fresh get_goal JSON or path>".

completionBudgetReport: Goal achieved. get_goal returned null after completion in this Codex App context, so this file records the structured update_goal completion payload used for OMX reconciliation.
